user.title: SRC - Shield Remote Center
user.description: Enable "Local API" in the app settings on the Shield, then enter its address and pairing token.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect. Is the Shield awake and the local API enabled?
error.invalid_auth: The Shield refused the pairing token

send_toast.name: Send a toast
send_toast.description: Display a discreet toast at the top of the Shield screen.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds before the notification disappears. 0 keeps it until a button or the Back key is pressed.

label.name: Label
label.description: Text of the button. Leave empty to not display this button.

type.name: What it does
type.description: What pressing the button does. If you choose an entity without choosing this, it is guessed: a script is run, an automation is triggered, anything else is toggled.

entity.name: Entity
entity.description: The script, automation, switch, light, boolean... the button acts on.

action.name: Custom action
action.description: Advanced: other actions run when the button is pressed, in addition to the above.

dismiss.name: Close on press
dismiss.description: Whether pressing the button closes the notification.

buttons.name: Buttons (YAML)
buttons.description: Advanced: list of buttons, each with a label, optional actions and dismiss. Added to the buttons above.
